messages.text:
"Juego 2D, género plataformas con combate lateral. Perspectiva, side-scroller, protagonista fijo en el lado izquierdo de la pantalla, movimiento horizontal, salto y ataques melee. Enemigos: monstruos de gran tamaño que spawnean desde el lado derecho, con patrones de ataque lentos. Progresión: niveles secuenciales con aumento de dificultad y drops de ítems. Entorno: background de montañas y árboles, con ciclo de iluminación día, atardecer, noche. Obstáculos en el path como huecos, spikes y troncos, que requieren timing de salto
"

messages.text: "A 2D platformer featuring side-scrolling combat. The game uses a side-scrolling perspective, with the protagonist fixed on the left side of the screen; gameplay involves horizontal movement, jumping, and melee attacks. Enemies consist of large monsters that appear from the right, characterized by slow attack patterns. Progression follows a sequence of levels with increasing difficulty and item drops. The environment features a backdrop of mountains and trees, with a lighting cycle that transitions through day, sunset, and night. Obstacles—such as gaps, spikes, and logs—are placed along the path, requiring precise timing for jumps."
